title: Methamphetamine Response Act of 2021
official_summary:
Methamphetamine Response Act of 2021

This bill designates methamphetamine as an emerging drug threat (a new and growing trend in the use of an illicit drug or class of drug). It also directs the Office of National Drug Control Policy to implement a methamphetamine response plan.

summary.headline: A 2022 law labels methamphetamine an emerging drug threat and directs the White House drug policy office to create a response plan.
summary.what_it_does: The law designates methamphetamine as an emerging drug threat, meaning a new and growing trend in the use of an illicit drug. It directs the Office of National Drug Control Policy to put a methamphetamine response plan into effect. The official summary does not list specific penalties, funding amounts, or new rules for individuals.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: Enacted March 14, 2022. The summary does not mention a separate effective date.
